idea: From the story bank (lead K1035), then-and-now format on two survey rounds.
alt_title: Andhra Pradesh: Women Who Have Used the Internet Tripled
description: In Andhra Pradesh, 21.0% of women aged 15 to 49 had ever used the internet in NFHS-5 (2019-21) and 63.6% in NFHS-6 (2023-24): three times the share. India went from 33.3% to 64.3%.
Andhra Pradesh started 12 points below the all-India figure and ended level with it. Every state and UT shown on the map rose; the smallest rises are in places that started high.
These are survey estimates, so small gaps are not differences. The survey shows how many, not why.
source: International Institute for Population Sciences, National Family Health Survey: NFHS-6 (2023-24) India and state fact sheets, which also print the NFHS-5 (2019-21) figure.
source_short: IIPS, National Family Health Survey, NFHS-6 state fact sheets.
question: Did your state rise more than India's 31 points?
pinned: Source: IIPS, NFHS-6 (2023-24) state fact sheets, with NFHS-5 (2019-21) for comparison. The measure is women aged 15 to 49 who have ever used the internet, not women who are online every day. Manipur has no NFHS-6 fact sheet yet and Lakshadweep's sample is small, so both are blank.
